note: Source review on 2026-11-23: llm-d-router v1.0.0 and main at 8f372a856464be9cf6fb009b6b433d43af531ddb; related vLLM-Omni and latency-predictor main. Warnings prompt checks; they do not block comparisons. The dashboard does not verify router versions, signals, backend cache hits or predictor health. caveats.details: Verify per-endpoint metrics and prediction coverage. Checked main skips predictions for never-scraped endpoints; with partial coverage, endpoints lacking predictions are ranked behind predicted candidates. With no predictions the scorer uses a KV/queue/prefix composite fallback. Encoder-cache predictor features are opt-in (useEncoderCacheFeatures=false by default); first-body and subsequent stream observations need not be first useful audio/text or engine-token timings.

caveats.reason: Input load may stop being counted after the first response. Check the output-estimation setting.
caveats.details: Verify inflight-load-producer accounting, not only tokenization. With addEstimatedOutputTokens=false (default), input load is released at the first response-body signal, or earlier on a compatible configured KV event, so ongoing generation may no longer contribute token load. Prefix-match data can discount input even without a prefix scorer in the selected profile. Output estimates are optional heuristics; non-text cost weighting in PR #2967 remains unmerged at the review commit.

caveats.reason: Check that EPP receives a useful KV-cache metric for the relevant stage.
caveats.details: Verify a meaningful per-endpoint KV metric and its stage labels. Checked main adds a built-in vllm-omni engine mapping for pipeline waiting/running counts but deliberately leaves KV usage unmapped; a successful scrape can then leave KV usage at zero and yield tied high scores. A custom AR-stage mapping may supply KV data, but it does not measure the whole multimodal pipeline or total GPU load. The dashboard does not inspect the mapping.
